Its straight shank design ensures a secure and stable fit with compatible drills and rotary tools, allowing smooth operation and better control during use. Ideal for workshops, fabrication, automotive maintenance, welding preparation, and general industrial use, this wire wheel brush is engineered to withstand demanding conditions while maintaining long service life. As a genuine Makita accessory, it meets strict quality standards for performance, reliability, and safety.
